Flagship history: '''Decipher World Championships 1996–2001'''. Each year has a hub (location, field, top cut, narrative, sourced decklists). Lists come from public pages after an archive.org / archive.today snapshot.

How the circuit was run (Swiss, ratings, decklist sheets): [[Tournaments]]. Event index: [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. European Championship years: [[European Championships]]. Blank-name sheets: [[Unknown players]].

The 1999 event was at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in Virginia Beach. The 2000 event was at [[DecipherCon 2000]] in Kissimmee, Florida, with surviving official photographs and the Final Confrontation video on that page. Playtest and travel groups are on [[Star Wars CCG teams]].

Players Committee Worlds from 2002 on are indexed on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. Year hubs on this wiki include [[2002 World Championship]] through [[2008 World Championship]] and [[2014 World Championship]] through [[2026 World Championship]] (gaps remain for 2009–2013).
